notes: Show: not recognised by name. It is a Netflix anime-style series (Thai Netflix dubbing credits at the end; opening song The Cure '10:15 Saturday Night (Remastered 2020)', ending song Petite Meller feat. Oslo Green 'Watson'); the style is Studio Trigger-like cyberpunk. So characters get descriptive names. Uncertain: (1) card 2 holds two looks: green/brown-lit round-goggled old man (C2T0-T3, 19:28-21:37, labelled old_cyborg, same as cards 6/7) and a greyscale grinning man with rectangular red goggles (C2T4,T6-T11, 8:28-10:29, labelled goggles_young_man); the latter may be the old cyborg's younger self in a flashback, in which case merge goggles_young_man into old_cyborg. C2T5 (greyscale bearded man with jaw bolts) left as old_cyborg. (2) Card 6 is mixed; old_cyborg is only a plurality (9 of 38 faces), next are 8 washed-out credits-art faces (unknown). (3) Card 8 majority is the lead boy (11 faces) over not-a-face (8, dark armoured torso + graphic) and 4 chin-only crops (C8T4, unknown). (4) Card 9 and C5T13/T14 (19:24-19:55) show a white/silver-haired figure in a lattice visor; I took it as the pink-haired girl under desaturated light (she is masked in the same scene). (5) C0T36 (11:41, dark eyes, simpler style) and C0T41 (24:13, magenta-lit) kept as the lead boy but less certain; U54/U55 (24:17-24:30, red-lit brown-haired face beside a green-eyed mask graphic) left unknown, and C0T41 may be the same person. (6) U42/U45 (20:04, 20:12, brown light, round goggles) labelled old_cyborg on context. U23, U24, U46 labelled blond_boy from hair only.
